name: possessive_determiner
description: Map subject pronouns to English possessive determiners in sentences, matched object-pronoun conversion control.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
rows=[('I','my','me'),('you','your','you'),('he','his','him'),('she','her','her'),('it','its','it'),('we','our','us'),('they','their','them')]
nouns=['book','bag','hat','desk','coat','phone','house','car','garden','chair','room','bicycle','umbrella','ticket','letter','pen','computer','key']
cs=[(r,n) for r in rows for n in nouns];random.shuffle(cs)
items=[];control=[]
for (s,p,o),n in cs[:120]:
 items.append({'prompt':f'Fill the blank with the possessive determiner for "{s}". This is ___ {n}.\nAnswer:','answer':' '+p})
 control.append({'prompt':f'Fill the blank with the object pronoun for "{s}". Please give the {n} to ___.\nAnswer:','answer':' '+o})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
